quizName:
Hardest Questions in New hampshire
									  					
									  														  					Most difficult questions from your region.

questions.question: You must stop your vehicle in which of these situations?

options.text: At an intersection with a stop sign.
When a traffic officer tells you to stop.

questions.explanation: You must stop in all these situations: at stop signs, at red lights, and when a traffic officer orders you to stop.

questions.question: What should you do when driving on major highways?

options.text: Be ready to react to road hazards.

questions.explanation: On highways, you must stay alert and keep your eyes moving to avoid highway hypnosis. Never look at one thing for more than a few seconds. Be ready to react to unexpected hazards.

questions.question: You are borrowing an unfamiliar vehicle from a friend. What should you do?

options.text: Not worry about it since all vehicles are the same.
Don't tell your friend you are unfamiliar with the vehicle.
Ignore any obvious defects to avoid embarrassing your friend.
Spend a few minutes learning where all controls are located and how they work before driving.

questions.correctAnswerText: Spend a few minutes learning where all controls are located and how they work before driving.
questions.explanation: Before driving an unfamiliar vehicle, take time to locate and learn how to use the turn signals, headlights, windshield wipers, brakes, gear selector, and horn. Fix any defects before driving.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Eight-sided signs mean you must stop and yield the right-of-way. You may drive when it is safe.

questions.question: What should you do when you see a school bus stopped with its stop arm extended?

options.text: Come to a complete stop and wait.
Honk your horn before passing on the left.
Keep driving when you think children are done exiting.
Pass the bus before its door opens.

questions.correctAnswerText: Come to a complete stop and wait.
questions.explanation: You must come to a complete stop when a school bus shows its stop signal. Do not drive until the stop arm is raised.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: You must not pass another vehicle.
You may pass a slow vehicle if you do it quickly.
You may pass if you know the road ahead.
You may pass only at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: You must not pass another vehicle.
questions.explanation: This is a regulatory sign. You must follow its instructions. This sign prohibits passing other vehicles.

questions.question: If you are in a serious motor vehicle crash, what should you do?
questions.explanation: Stop your vehicle and move it off the road if possible. If anyone is injured, call 911. You must report crashes to police if there is an injury, death, or more than $1,000 in property damage.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This yellow warning sign alerts you to an upcoming traffic signal. Be ready for red lights, yellow lights, and cross traffic.

questions.question: You are angry after a bad incident at work. What should you do before driving home?

options.text: Play the radio loudly to distract yourself.
Drive fast on the interstate to release stress.
Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
Stop at a bar for a few drinks before driving home.

questions.correctAnswerText: Take a few minutes to calm down before driving.
questions.explanation: Never drive when you are upset or angry. Take time to calm down first. Driving while emotional is dangerous for you and others.

questions.question: On a freeway, you realize you missed your exit. What should you do?

options.text: Continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.
Signal other drivers to stop so you can turn.

questions.correctAnswerText: Continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.
questions.explanation: Do not back up on a freeway or shoulder. Continue to the next exit or turn where you can safely turn around.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: A red circle with a red slash through it means something is not allowed. This sign means U-turns are prohibited.

questions.question: Alcohol causes:
questions.explanation: Even a small amount of alcohol hurts your vision, judgment, concentration, and coordination.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means U-turns are not allowed where it is posted.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: Regulation signs tell drivers what they must do. This sign means left turns are not allowed.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Watch for traffic on your right.
Don't park on the right side of the street.

questions.explanation: A red circle with a slash means the action is not allowed. This sign means right turns are not allowed.

questions.question: A person's driving ability can be impaired by:
questions.explanation: Safe driving requires good physical condition. Alcohol, drugs, and fatigue all hurt your ability to drive safely.

questions.question: If someone is driving aggressively behind you, you should:

options.text: Get out of the aggressive driver's way.
Stare at the driver as they pass you.
Speed up as they pass you.

questions.correctAnswerText: Get out of the aggressive driver's way.
questions.explanation: When you see an aggressive driver, move out of their way. Do not make eye contact. Do not speed up or block them, as this can make them angrier and more dangerous.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?

options.text: Fines double in a work zone.

questions.explanation: Warning signs are yellow with black markings. They alert drivers to hazards ahead. This sign warns you that bicycles may cross the road.

questions.question: Distracted driving can be caused by:

options.text: Talking or texting on a phone.
Changing a radio station or CD.

questions.explanation: Drivers must pay full attention to the road. Any activity other than driving is a dangerous distraction.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: You are entering a one-way street the wrong way.
Do not drive in this lane.
Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.

questions.correctAnswerText: Left-turning traffic on green must yield to oncoming traffic.
questions.explanation: This sign with a traffic signal tells drivers that left turns on green do not have the right-of-way. Left-turning drivers must wait for oncoming traffic to clear.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign is placed at the start of one-way streets and ramps. It tells you not to drive in that direction.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot make a U-turn where it is posted.

questions.question: How can alcohol affect you while driving?

options.text: It gives you a feeling of false confidence.

questions.explanation: Alcohol slows your reaction time and makes you feel overly confident. It also hurts your judgment and your ability to see clearly and judge distance.

questions.question: What should you do when approaching railroad tracks?

options.text: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
Speed up to cross the tracks before the gate is lowered.
Try to drive around a lowered gate.
Not pay attention to how many tracks there are to cross.

questions.correctAnswerText: Look, listen, slow down, and be prepared to stop.
questions.explanation: Always look, listen, slow down, and be ready to stop for trains or other vehicles on the tracks.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign means you cannot turn left.

questions.question: What should you do before turning?
questions.explanation: Signal your turn 3 to 4 seconds before you turn.

questions.question: When turning or changing lanes, you must:

options.text: Always signal your intentions, even when no visible traffic is present.
Signal only if there is visible traffic.
Signal only when driving at night.
Signal only when driving in heavy traffic at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: Always signal your intentions, even when no visible traffic is present.
questions.explanation: Always signal when changing lanes, turning, or pulling away from a curb, even if you do not see other cars.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells you that parking is not allowed.

questions.question: What should you do when you encounter an aggressive driver?

options.text: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
Cut them off to slow them down.
Make sure they know you disapprove of their behavior.

questions.correctAnswerText: Avoid eye contact, slow down, and let them pass.
questions.explanation: Stay calm and try to create distance. Slow down and let them pass. Do not make eye contact or make rude gestures.

questions.question: When is it important to slow down?

options.text: When the road is wet or slippery.

questions.explanation: Slow down on narrow or winding roads, near intersections, near railroad crossings, on hills, in sharp curves, around pedestrians, and when roads are wet or slippery.

questions.question: What does this road sign mean?

options.text: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
Traffic in this lane must turn in the direction shown by the arrow.
These lanes are for buses and carpools only.

questions.correctAnswerText: These parking spaces are for people with disabled parking permits.
questions.explanation: This sign marks parking spaces reserved for people with disabled parking permits.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign warns you that a railroad crossing is coming. Watch for trains and be ready to stop.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This regulation sign tells drivers that U-turns are not allowed at this location.

questions.question: Why is night driving more difficult than day driving?

options.text: Cars overheat more quickly at night.
It is harder to see in the dark.
It rains more often at night.
You are more likely to see motorcycles at night.

questions.correctAnswerText: It is harder to see in the dark.
questions.explanation: At night, you cannot see as far ahead. Use your headlights and drive slowly enough to stop within the distance you can see.

questions.question: What documents must you have when stopped by police?
questions.explanation: You must carry your driver's license, proof of registration, and proof of insurance whenever you drive. Have all three ready if stopped by police.

questions.question: This sign shows one type of:
questions.explanation: This sign warns that an intersection with a crossing road is ahead.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This sign tells drivers the direction they must drive on a one-way street.

questions.question: What does this sign mean?
questions.explanation: This warning sign tells drivers that traffic may be coming from the opposite direction.

questions.question: What could cause you to crash?

options.text: Taking your eyes off the road
Taking your hands off the wheel
Taking your attention away from driving

questions.explanation: Any distraction that takes your eyes, hands, or attention away from driving can cause a crash.

questions.question: What should you do if you miss your freeway exit?

options.text: Make a U-turn through the median.
Pull onto the shoulder and back up to your exit.
Flag down a police officer to help you.

questions.explanation: Always go to the next exit if you miss your turn. Do not back up, stop, or make a U-turn on the highway. These actions are illegal and dangerous.
